question: How many of the account holders in South Bohemia still do not own credit cards?

auxiliary_raw_evidence_draft.base_sql:
SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT T1.client_id)
FROM district_client AS T1
INNER JOIN account AS T2 ON T1.district_id = T2.district_id
INNER JOIN disp AS T3 ON T2.account_id = T3.account_id
WHERE T1.A3 = 'south Bohemia'
  AND T3.client_id NOT IN (
    SELECT T4.client_id
    FROM disp AS T4
    INNER JOIN card AS T5 ON T4.disp_id = T5.disp_id
  )

base_solution_anchor.base_sql:
SELECT COUNT(T1.account_id) FROM account AS T1
INNER JOIN district_client AS T2 ON T1.district_id = T2.district_id
LEFT JOIN disp AS T3 ON T1.account_id = T3.account_id
LEFT JOIN card AS T4 ON T3.disp_id = T4.disp_id
WHERE T2.A3 = 'south Bohemia' AND T4.card_id IS NULL
